title: Charlie Christian in Oklahoma City and Jimmy Blanton's mother
summary: He knew Christian as a boy taking lessons from Eddie Durham, and played gigs in Chattanooga with Jimmy Blanton's mother, a pianist, before Blanton joined Ellington.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Oh, I knew Charlie Christian in Oklahoma City. And he used to come over and when we went there with Benny Morton he used to come and take guitar lessons from Eddie Durham. Charlie Christian and Blanton from Tennessee,
I played with his mother down in Chattanooga, Tennessee.
So you remember both of them when they were young kids?
I was in Tennessee -- well, I told you I took sick there, Zach White left me there in Chattanooga. And I stayed there about three months. And I used to play gigs with Jimmy Blanton's mother.
He wasn't around at the time?
No. So I met him later after he joined Duke's band, you know. And so anyway, --
